reading.purpose: The live measurement. The largest type in the system, and always a number.

data.purpose: Table cells. Tabular numerals, figures right-aligned.

label.purpose: Column headers and captions. Never uppercase-tracked.

motion.name: ease-out-quart
motion.purpose: The only easing. State changes settle rather than bounce.

motion.name: duration-state
motion.purpose: A live figure holding Signal Blue on arrival, then returning to ink.

components.name: Segmented control
components.description: Timeframe selection. Silent at rest, background on hover, border plus background when selected.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: flex; gap: 0.25rem; font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; } .ds-seg-item { height: 2rem; min-width: 2.75rem; font: inherit; color: #6f6658; background: none; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg-item:hover { color: #2a251f; background: #f4f1ea; } .ds-seg-item[aria-pressed="true"] { color: #2a251f; background: #f4f1ea; border-color: #e2dbce; } .ds-seg-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0b4f9c; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Pair select
components.description: Standard select, the same 2rem height as every control beside it.
components.css: .ds-select { height: 2rem; font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; color: #2a251f; background: #f4f1ea; border: 1px solid #e2dbce; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0 0.5rem; } .ds-select:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0b4f9c; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Live reading
components.description: The watched figure with its caption. Takes Signal Blue for 180ms as a value arrives, and says nothing about direction.
components.css: .ds-reading { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.75rem; flex-wrap: wrap; font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; } .ds-reading-n { font-size: 2rem; color: #2a251f; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; transition: color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-reading-n[data-fresh="true"] { color: #0b4f9c; } .ds-reading-n[data-stale="true"] { color: #6f6658; } .ds-reading-at { color: #6f6658; font-size: 0.76rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-reading-n { transition: none; } }

components.name: Provenance line
components.description: The panel's receipt: the topics it is subscribed to, verbatim, at the foot of the panel.
components.css: .ds-source { font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; color: #6f6658; font-size: 0.76rem; margin: 0; }

components.name: Data table
components.description: Hairline rows, no outer border, no striping, figures right-aligned on tabular numerals.
components.css: .ds-table-wrap { overflow-x: auto; } .ds-table { border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.84rem; color: #2a251f; } .ds-table th, .ds-table td { text-align: right; padding: 0.35rem 0.6rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2dbce; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-table th:first-child, .ds-table td:first-child { text-align: left; } .ds-table thead th { color: #6f6658; font-weight: 400; font-size: 0.76rem; } .ds-table tbody tr:last-child td { border-bottom: 0; }

components.name: State line
components.description: How loading, empty and error speak: a sentence naming what is happening and what to do next.
components.html:
Subscribed to BTCUSDT on 1m. Waiting for the market to move.

The channel is unreachable. Start the API with pnpm dev:api; this page reconnects on its own.
components.css: .ds-state { font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; color: #6f6658; margin: 0 0 0.5rem; max-width: 70ch; } .ds-state strong { color: #2a251f; font-weight: 600; } .ds-state-bad { color: #b3271e; } .ds-state code { background: #f4f1ea; padding: 0.05em 0.3em; border-radius: 3px; }

narrative.overview: This is the dial of a measuring device, not a trading floor. Figures are etched onto a pale ground; the scale marks are thin and few; nothing on the surface is there to be admired. Density serves reading at a distance before it serves cramming, because the screen is judged in a fifteen-minute demo over a projector. It explicitly rejects the neon exchange and the beginner investing app, the two shapes closest to this subject.
keyCharacteristics: One monospace family for everything; the numbers align because they are meant to be compared.
Warm off-white ground, ink-brown text, one blue accent used only for state.
No shadows anywhere; depth is a change of ground plus a hairline.
Four states on every surface, and none of them may be mistaken for another.

rules.name: The Meaning-Only Rule
rules.body: Colour appears when it carries information and at no other time. If a colour cannot be explained by what it tells the reader, it is removed.

rules.name: The Never-Alone Rule
rules.body: Green and red never carry meaning by themselves. A colour-blind reader and a black-and-white printout must reach the same conclusion.

rules.name: The Biggest-Thing-Is-A-Number Rule
rules.body: The largest type on any screen is a measurement. If a heading out-sizes the figure it introduces, the screen is advertising itself.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: No small uppercase tracked eyebrow above a section. A panel is named by its heading and nothing else.

rules.name: The Column Rule
rules.body: One column, one reading order. Two columns arrive only when two things are genuinely being compared side by side.

rules.name: The Two-Plane Rule
rules.body: Ground and held. Anything that appears to need a third plane is a layout problem wearing a costume.

rules.name: The Operable-Corner Rule
rules.body: A rounded corner means the thing can be operated. If it cannot be clicked, typed into or selected, it is square.

dos: Do put the largest type on the measurement, and keep headings at 1rem-1.4rem.
Do convey depth with Recessed Enamel plus a 1px Hairline, never a shadow.
Do give every focusable element the same 2px Signal Blue outline at 1px offset.
Do set font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums wherever digits stack.
Do write all four states as sentences that name what is happening and what to do next.
Do pair every green or red with a word or a shape.
Do keep one control height per row (2rem) and one radius family (3px / 6px).
donts: Don't build a neon crypto exchange: no purple-to-cyan gradients, no blinking figures, no badges, no glow.
Don't build a beginner investing app: no oversized green and red, no arrows, no magnified percentages, nothing that nudges.
Don't wrap content in cards, and never nest one inside another.
Don't add a second font family, and never a display face.
Don't put a small uppercase tracked eyebrow above a section.
Don't use border-left thicker than 1px as a coloured accent stripe.
Don't compute a percentage, a direction or a profit in a component to colour something.
